command: bash tools/proofpunk-install.sh --target claude-code --source github --ref v2.1.0 --only proofpunk
capture_method: unpiped; stdout+stderr redirected to file, rc read from $? immediately after the command (no pipeline)
significance: Closes the last open arm of improvement 3. Before this release the upstream repository had zero tags, so the refs/tags/ code path could be written but not driven, and the arm was reported UNVERIFIED rather than PASS. Cutting the v2.1.0 release tag made it drivable, and it resolves.
